name: Fret
author: Erin Carter
description: A living labyrinth: a Truchet weave of quarter-turn paths connects edge to edge into one continuous meander that fills the whole frame, no empty centre and no border band. The paths glow in slowly shifting palette hues while bright currents of light course along them like charge running through a circuit.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: Size of each path cell in CSS pixels - a dense fine labyrinth at the minimum, broad sweeping meanders at the maximum.

params.label: Line weight
params.effect: Core thickness of the glowing path in CSS pixels, from a hairline trace to a fat neon conduit.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the bright currents travelling the paths; 0 freezes the light as static beads, high sends it coursing through the labyrinth.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each path; low is a crisp drawn line, high a luminous bloom that floods the maze with light.

params.label: Weld
params.effect: How the travelling light joins across cells; 0 segments it into beads with a hard seam at every tile edge, 1 welds the cells into one seamless coursing flow.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Re-rolls which cells turn which way, shuffling the whole labyrinth into a fresh maze without changing its density or style.
